name: OSS_USAGE_BILL_LINES_T
description: Following table be used to capture bill line identifier impacted by event rating job.

columns.name: USAGE_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for usage bill line.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: It tracks the subscription product id for usage bill line.

columns.name: RATING_MODEL
columns.description: It tracks the rating model for usage bill line.

columns.name: SUMMARIZED_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: It tracks the summarized charge flag for usage bill line.

columns.name: EVENT_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: It tracks the event charge flag for usage bill line.

columns.name: TRUEUP_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: It tracks the true up charge flag for usage bill line.

columns.name: EVENT_BILLING_FLAG
columns.description: It tracks the event billing flag for usage bill line.

columns.name: SUMMARIZED_BILLING_FLAG
columns.description: It tracks the summarized billing flag for usage bill line.

columns.name: TRUEUP_BILLING_FLAG
columns.description: It tracks the true up billing flag for usage bill line.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ROOT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field stores the unique identifier of the root bill line linked to the usage bill line.

columns.name: PARENT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field records the unique identifier of the parent bill line that is linked to the usage bill line..

columns.name: BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field records the unique identifier of the bill line that is linked to the usage bill line..

columns.name: BILL_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: This field stores the bill sequence number that uniquely identifies the billing instance linked to the specific usage bill line.

columns.name: NEW_PARENT_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field records the unique identifier of the new parent bill line that is linked to the usage bill line..

columns.name: NEW_BILL_LINE_ID
columns.description: This field records the unique identifier of the new bill line that is linked to the usage bill line..

columns.name: NEW_BILL_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: This field stores the new bill sequence number that uniquely identifies the billing instance linked to the specific usage bill line.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
